seats.findings:
🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, so couponCents(1000, 10) returns 10 instead of 100 and every discount (and checkoutTotal via it) is 10x too small; change the divisor to 100
🟠 [ship-started-block] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:6 uses Math.floor(extra / 500), so a partially started extra 500 g block is not charged (1001 g yields 500 instead of 600, contradicting "each started additional 500 g"); use Math.ceil(extra / 500)

🟠 [coupon-div-1000] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 the discount divides by 1000 instead of 100, making every coupon 10x too small (subtotal=10000, pct=50 returns 500 instead of 5000), and checkoutTotal at src/checkout.js:6 inherits the same wrong discount through couponCents; smallest remediation: change `/ 1000` to `/ 100`
🟠 [ship-floor-not-ceil] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:6 Math.floor only charges completed 500 g increments while the contract charges per started increment, so 1001 g returns 500 instead of 600 and 1501 g returns 600 instead of 700; smallest remediation: replace Math.floor with Math.ceil in `Math.ceil(extra / 500) * 100`

🟠 [coupon-wrong-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, producing a discount ten times too small (e.g. couponCents(1000, 10) returns 10 instead of 100); change `/ 1000` to `/ 100`
🟠 [ship-floor-vs-ceil] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:6 uses Math.floor for "each started additional 500 g", undercharging any weight that is not an exact multiple of 500 above 1000 g (e.g. 1001 g returns 500 instead of 600); replace Math.floor with Math.ceil
